description:
* Prepare and cook Japanese dishes, including Kaiseki cuisine, in accordance with the Head Chef's standards and recipes.
* Take charge of the counter section, preparing and presenting dishes directly in front of guests.
* Handle the preparation, storage, and preservation of seafood and imported ingredients.
* Maintain cleanliness and hygiene in the kitchen area in compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations.
requirements_text:
* At least 3 years of experience in Japanese cuisine at a Japanese restaurant.
* Proficient in knife skills, sushi and sashimi preparation, and basic Kaiseki cooking techniques.
* Possess a Food Safety and Hygiene Certificate or be willing to attend the required food safety training.
* Good attention to detail, a strong sense of responsibility, and the ability to work in a professional kitchen environment.
